records.safety_approach: Uses stated conduct, risk, restriction, reporting, or safety controls; MORT must retain emergency escalation and victim-centered treatment.

records.minor_user_approach: Contains child, youth, age, parent, or guardian treatment that requires comparison with MORT's 13-17 role and optional Guardian Mode.
records.privacy_approach: Addresses personal information, privacy rights, retention, or deletion; MORT must apply minimization to location, evidence, documents, and youth data.
records.location_approach: Addresses location or address data; MORT should release exact job locations only after authorization and record the release state.
records.verification_approach: Discusses identity, screening, background checks, or biometrics; MORT must label each signal precisely and avoid calling nonauthoritative checks identity proof.
records.limitation_of_liability_approach: Contains liability, warranty, indemnity, or insurance allocation that cannot be transferred to MORT without attorney review and nonwaivable-right analysis.
